name: io.redstick/record
title: Redstick: construction tech on the record
description: A dated record of construction robots, software and AI tools, each read at the maker's source.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search Redstick's dated record of construction robots, software and AI tools by words, job, trade or kind. Free. Returns up to 10 tools a call, each with what it does, who it suits, the catch and the price as the maker states it.

q.description: words to look for in a tool's name, maker, description, trades and jobs

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: One tool from Redstick's record in full: the verdict, the source read, features, where it is sold and what it connects to, as it stands today. Free.

slug.description: the tool's slug, as search_tools returns it

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: The jobs on site that tools on Redstick's record are filed under, each with its stage of the work. Free.

tools.name: list_trades
tools.description: The trades that tools on Redstick's record are filed under. Free.

tools.name: list_systems
tools.description: The systems and file formats that tools on Redstick's record say they connect to, with how many tools name each. Free. Without q, only systems named by three or more tools.

q.description: part of a system's name, e.g. revit

min_tools.description: only systems named by at least this many tools; default 3, or 1 with q

tools.name: query_record
tools.description: Redstick's record filtered by job, trade, kind, country sold in, maker's country or connected system, each tool in full with its dated log of changes. Paid per call by x402 in USDC: $0.05 a call including the first 10 tools returned, then $0.02 for each further tool (the most a call can cost, at 200 tools, is $3.850); set limit to hold the cost. The exact price is stated before anything is paid. A call that cannot be answered as asked, or that finds nothing, is free.

country.description: two-letter country code where the tool is sold, e.g. GB

maker_country.description: the maker's country by name, e.g. Germany

tools.name: what_changed
tools.description: What changed on Redstick's record since a date: every tool whose record changed, in full, with those changes. Paid per call by x402 in USDC: $0.05 a call including the first 10 tools returned, then $0.02 for each further tool (the most a call can cost, at 200 tools, is $3.850); set limit to hold the cost. The exact price is stated before anything is paid. A call that cannot be answered as asked, or that finds nothing, is free.

since.description: YYYY-MM-DD: tools whose record changed on or after this date, with those changes

country.description: two-letter country code where the tool is sold, e.g. GB

maker_country.description: the maker's country by name, e.g. Germany
